result.summary: Found 1 major content/data issue: a delivery fee is displaying as 'NaN', indicating a data formatting or calculation error.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' item shows '€NaN delivery', indicating a broken value where a numeric delivery fee should appear. NaN (Not a Number) is a code-level error leaking into the UI.
issues.suggestion: Fix the underlying data/calculation so a valid delivery fee is shown, or add a fallback (e.g. 'Free delivery' or hide the field) when the fee value is unavailable.
